Add resolvePointer: JSON Pointer resolution (RFC 6901)

Implements resolvePointer(document, pointer) in src/index.ts. It returns the
value a JSON Pointer refers to and throws a SyntaxError for an invalid pointer
and an Error when the pointer does not resolve. Tests run with npm test; the
README documents the function.
